editorial:
Imagine being the perfect employee by day and a massive criminal by night. You get to see this play out through Dan Mahowny, a young bank manager in Toronto who seems to have his whole life together. Everyone loves him because he is smart and helpful, but he has a secret that is eating him alive. He is addicted to gambling, and to keep his bets going, he starts stealing millions from his own bank. The vibe is a wild ride that shows how easy it is to lie to everyone when you look like the guy who never makes mistakes.

What really makes this work is the acting, as you feel the stress and panic as Dan tries to cover his tracks. The pacing is quick and keeps you guessing if he will get caught in the next scene. While some parts feel a bit repetitive, the tension makes up for it. You should definitely check this out if you like true crime stories about greedy people.
endingExplained: Everything falls apart when the bank finally notices the missing money. Dan tries to keep lying, but the evidence is too strong. He is eventually caught and arrested for his massive fraud. The movie ends by showing that no matter how smart he thought he was, his gambling addiction ruined his life. He loses his job, his reputation, and his freedom, proving that the house always wins in the end.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves true crime and heist movies.
